fee_notes: $10,000 non-refundable deposit due with application; balance due within 10 days after approval. Reduced or no fee for conversion franchisees, relocating franchisees, and multi-unit operators meeting certain criteria. MultiTRA franchisees pay $22,500 per restaurant as trade area reservation fee, credited against franchise fee.
raw_excerpt: You must pay ADQ a $45,000 initial franchise fee for a single franchise, the first $10,000 of which is a non-refundable deposit due when you submit a franchise application.
